name: WordWorld fourth fresh 50-command evaluation — 2026-10-15
method: 50 newly hand-authored commands and expected actions frozen before prediction after post-noun/coordination fixes. Author saw implementation and prior results; not independently human-labeled or randomly sampled. No tuning on round-four results.
scope: 40 preassigned core cases and 10 broader grammar probes. Request-local reference contract and existing count caps apply. Core includes two zero/negative-count refusal cases, one informal with+part+is phrase, and a named-type landmark case that does not test color filtering. Coordination scores count/color groups; sizes are not rendered or scored. Geometry and cross-request context are not scored.
evaluation_kind: retest after parser development; not unseen-command accuracy

metric_definitions.exact_match: Complete ordered action dictionaries match, including all emitted fields; per command over all 50.
metric_definitions.intent: Ordered action-name sequence matches; per command over all 50. Does not validate entity or setting value.
metric_definitions.entity_count_color: Ordered (action, type, count, color) tuples for all typed actions match, per command over all 50. Pure setting/no-op cases contribute empty typed-action lists.
metric_definitions.spatial: Ordered (type, relation, target, targets) tuples for all typed actions match, on gold-spatial commands only. Extra subjects are penalized.
metric_definitions.settings: Ordered (key, value) tuples for setting actions match, on gold-setting commands only.

cases.text: Build four cottages whose roofs are purple.
Plant two trees with yellow foliage.
Create five flowers whose petals are white.
Place a cottage which is pink next to the stream.
Grow three trees having orange leaves.
Add two blossoms in yellow.
Build a cabin with the roof is red.
cases.label_note: A deliberately informal phrase within the implemented with + part + is grammar, not a claim of general relative-clause support.

cases.text: Place three flowers that are blue behind the tower.

Plant trees, seven altogether.
Add flowers, eleven in total.
Build bridges, two pairs of them across the river.
Place towers, half a dozen in total.
Add stones, thirty-two of them.
cases.label_note: Existing per-action cap applies to 32 requested objects.

cases.text: Create castles, three of them behind the pond.
